subject.title: [Feature]: Owner Takeover / Human Handoff for DM Auto-Reply

question: Should OpenClaw add owner/human handoff for DM auto-reply, and should the first supported contract be WhatsApp-plugin-owned or shared across WhatsApp, Telegram, and Discord?
rationale: The request adds new config, message-suppression state, and resume semantics that affect channel delivery behavior, so code cannot safely choose the permanent product contract without maintainer intent.

options.title: WhatsApp Plugin First
options.body: Add the handoff behavior to the WhatsApp plugin/config surface first, with live proof and a later path to generalize if users need it across channels.

options.title: Shared Channel Contract
options.body: Design a common channel handoff API and implement WhatsApp, Telegram, and Discord together, accepting a larger compatibility and review surface.

options.title: Defer Feature
options.body: Keep current prompt/manual-pause workarounds until stronger live evidence or maintainer sponsorship justifies new config and pause-state surface.

recommendation.title: WhatsApp Plugin First
recommendation.body: Add the handoff behavior to the WhatsApp plugin/config surface first, with live proof and a later path to generalize if users need it across channels.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent path history shows broad channel/plugin config and WhatsApp runtime work, and the decision spans config policy plus channel delivery behavior.
